meta.description: Calculate alignment statistics including sequence identity, conservation scores, substitution matrices, and similarity metrics. Use when comparing alignment quality, measuring sequence divergence, and analyzing evolutionary patterns.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported values were asserted against independently constructed data, Pwalign, ModelTest-NG, or deterministic conservation and distance invariants; no fabricated research results were emitted.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill reports alignment statistics and explicitly routes publication-grade evolutionary-distance modelling to dedicated tools; it makes no diagnostic or treatment claims.

methodological_ground.detail: Runs confirmed normalization, occupancy exclusion, gap/gap handling, alphabet-specific information-content bounds, and the documented ModelTest-NG handoff.

code_usability.detail: All 10 executable examples, the Pwalign comparison, both ModelTest-NG invocations, and the 11 audit inputs completed from an audit-owned source copy.

functional_suitability.note: Identity, conservation, information content, substitutions, gaps, quality scores, and distance handoff all have an executable or directly referenced route.

reliability.note: The Skill documents normalization, alphabet warnings, undefined NaN cases, occupancy handling, ragged-A2M boundaries, and concrete recovery routes.

performance_context.note: A compact SKILL.md directs conditional reading of focused references and examples; the unavoidable exact N-by-N identity cost is explicitly bounded.

agent_usability.note: Goals, decision table, executable import route, explicit metric definitions, common errors, and reference routing are consistently specified.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger prompts, metric interpretation, warning-sign table, and short usage guide make the scope discoverable.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations, or raw user-code execution appear. File paths are necessarily user supplied, so callers retain normal filesystem-scope responsibility.

maintainability.note: Shared normalization/background helpers, focused examples, reference index, deterministic selftest, and clear version notes support isolated maintenance.

agent_specific.note: Trigger is precise, examples are composable, re-runs are deterministic, and explicit handoffs cover ragged A2M and publication-grade distance modelling.

key_strengths: Normalization and alphabet boundaries are explicit, shared by examples, and independently exercised on lowercase, dot-gapped, RNA, IUPAC-rich and unknown-residue inputs.
PID1-PID4 definitions withstand a 169-pair Pwalign comparison, staggered-flank reconstruction, scalar/vectorized agreement, and hand-defined edge cases.
Occupancy-aware conservation, NaN-safe ranking, information-content bounds, and gap/gap scoring have deterministic tests that catch their historical failure modes.
Publication-grade distance modelling is safely handed off to ModelTest-NG while the exploratory Biopython calculation remains runnable and clearly scoped.
